data_fields.name: node_copies_max_allowed
data_fields.donor_constant: max_allowed per ground-spawn row (live copies at once)

data_fields.name: node_respawn_s
data_fields.donor_constant: respawn_timer per row, multiplied by 1000 to ms in the object constructor (read as seconds)

data_fields.name: node_box
data_fields.donor_constant: min_x, max_x, min_y, max_y per row; point drawn uniformly inside

data_fields.name: forage_zone_table_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: ForageChance = 25 percent (zone table vs common list)

data_fields.name: combine_base_below_68
data_fields.donor_constant: chance = skill - trivial + 66 when trivial < 68; clamp 5..95 below trivial

data_fields.name: combine_slope_over_trivial
data_fields.donor_constant: chance = 95 + (skill - trivial)/40 at or over trivial, no cap

data_fields.name: skillup_stage2_mid_band
data_fields.donor_constant: (200 - skill)/2 for skill 15 to 174 (integer division in donor)

best_idea: A zone row describes a gathering node (a box, a live-copy count, a respawn delay); the server pays once per live copy on click, starts its timer, and re-places it at a random point in the box when the timer is due.
decision_why: Keep the row-as-node shape and the server-side click that pays only a live copy; set copies and respawn seconds as zone data; add the walkability check the donor lacks. The donor is GPL-3.0, so clean-room only.
acceptance: Server test on a copper vein row (max_allowed 2, respawn 300 s): the first click pays one copper ore, a second click on the same copy pays nothing, and after 300 s the copy is placed inside the row's box again.
